audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers state that Ragnarok beats Teemo's blind. full.breakdown.cooldowns reads "Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — Cleanses your blind — he runs you down", and content.wants.foe[1] reads "Press Ragnarok (R) to ignore Blinding Shot's movement-impairing effect".
audit.why: Both halves of that are wrong. Blind is not crowd control and is not on Ragnarok's removal list — the wiki's status table shows Ragnarok removing stuns, roots and forced actions, with blind removable only by Cleanse and Quicksilver. And Blinding Dart has no movement-impairing component at all; it blinds, it does not slow. The net effect is that a Teemo player is being told his single best button is countered at level 6 when it is not, so he stops pressing it in exactly the fight where it still works.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok clears stuns and slows but leaves the blind intact — keep Q on him through his ult and his basic attacks keep missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explained what actually kills Teemo here, and Reckless Swing was mentioned only in passing.
audit.why: Reckless Swing is an ability, not a basic attack, so blind has no bearing on it, and it deals true damage, so Teemo's MR build has none either. On an 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown at 325 range it is Olaf's real kill pattern: Undertow slow, walk in, two Reckless Swings. That — not Ragnarok — is why this matchup sits under 50% for Teemo.
audit.corrected: Reckless Swing is the threat to respect: true damage on 11s at rank 1, untouched by blind or by magic resist. Trade in the gap after he spends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[2] claimed Olaf "leaks HP through every exchange" as a straightforward win for Teemo's poke pattern.
audit.why: Berserker Rage grants Olaf attack speed and lifesteal scaling with MISSING health. Chip damage therefore feeds the exact stat line that wins him the brawl. Poking Olaf down without killing him is not banking an advantage — it is powering him up.
audit.corrected: Poke him low and you are arming him; either commit to the kill or keep the poison purely as zoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow was treated as a normal 9-second cooldown to wait out.
audit.why: Undertow's cooldown is refunded outright when Olaf picks the axe back up, so the effective cooldown against a competent Olaf is far shorter than 9s. Advice built on waiting out the slow fails unless the player also denies the pickup.
audit.corrected: Deny the axe pickup or the slow is effectively always available.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.win gave Teemo 6 of 7 stages in a matchup Teemo loses at 45.41%, and it contradicted the file's own prose.
audit.why: The same entry already says Olaf is "genuinely dangerous" at 6 (whys[4]), that his first-item spike "runs you down" (spikes[3]), and that 2+ items is a coin flip (whys[6]) — yet the chart handed Teemo every one of those stages. Levels 3 and 4-5 are where Reckless Swing's cooldown falls to 8-9s, level 6 is Ragnarok, and first item is by the file's own account a close race.
audit.corrected: Chart moved to Teemo / Teemo / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Skill / Skill, which matches both the 45.41% figure and the prose already in the file.

audit.why: 45.41% over 621 games — the weakest matchup in this slice, which is why it got the most work.

notes: This was the worst entry in the slice. The claim that Ragnarok cleanses Teemo's blind appears FOUR times: three in champ-data/teemo.full.js (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t) and once in champ-data/teemo.js. My edits fix all three in the full layer. The fourth is OUTSIDE the two writable layers and I did not touch it — champ-data/teemo.js carries, for the Olaf matchup: donts: ["Blind during his R (cleansed)", ...] and key: { slot: "R", name: "Ragnarok", cd: "100s", note: "Cleanses your blind - he runs you down.", winT: "RAGNAROK DOWN" }. That donts entry actively tells the player to stop pressing Q during Ragnarok, which is the exact moment the blind still works. It needs the same correction applied by hand or by a separate tool pass. Grep confirms the phrase does not appear anywhere else in champ-data, so this is contained to Teemo vs Olaf.
